body:
The 2026 World Cup is shaping up to be an exciting tournament, with African teams making their presence felt. While the likes of Brazil, Germany, and Spain are still among the favorites to win it all, teams like Nigeria, Morocco, Senegal, Egypt, and South Africa are causing a stir.

We take a look at the latest news and betting markets for these African teams, and what it means for sports bettors in Africa.

One of the biggest stories coming out of the tournament is the controversy surrounding Iran's Taremi, who has spoken out about the tension between teams and the need to preserve the joy of the game. This sentiment is echoed by fans and players alike, who want to see the beautiful game celebrated for what it is – a unifying force that brings people together.

However, not all teams are taking it as easy. Thomas Tuchel's set-piece plan for England has sparked interest, with his tactical acumen and ability to exploit weaknesses in the opposition. With prominent figures in England's World Cup squad, this is a strategy that could pay off big time.

As for the African teams, they have their work cut out for them. With the likes of Spain and Belgium set to dominate the group stages, it's going to take some exceptional performances to make it out on top.

In the betting markets, Nigeria is looking like a dark horse, with odds of 7.00 to 9.00 at Bet9ja and Sportybet. Morocco, meanwhile, is priced at 4.00 to 6.00, while Senegal is a more modest 3.50 to 5.00.
